title: How do I do… what you guys do?
author: Scrapp0r
selftext:
Hi everyone,

TL:DR- I built an educational game for my son and I want to move from the blocky world I built to something that will impress him more. 

Context:   
There are some incredible things being built on here. I have been using Claude for the past 9 months with work and have begun trying to use it to create educational video games for my kids. 

My son is struggling with his spelling and really resists sitting down to practice. He’s 10. He loves video games so I built a driving and base building game in which he needs to do spelling missions to earn car parts. He also needs to beat the bots which have taken over areas of the map by spelling their words. If he does this then he can unlock new areas of the map.   
He can also customise his base and each word earns him credits which get converted into pocket money at the end of the week. 

It seems to be working so far, but he also has access to proper video games by developers and so I want to level up my game soon so it keeps his interest. 

I’ve attached a screenshot of my game and my question is: how would you go about improving the graphical appearance of it? I read a bit on Godot and Unity. I work long hours and just try to keep this building on the side so I probably need to take the path of less resistance. 

If anyone can help me through the natural iterations to improve this then I’d be grateful. I’ve got the pro plan which gives me small 5 hour bursts, but I’d consider going Max for a month or trialling other AI to get this done. 

Any help is appreciated!

replies.body: Good idea, I like the idea of increasingly difficult bosses. I think I could add some sea monsters here!

comments.author: SrZerix
comments.body:
Consigue Codex, con la sub más barata es suficiente. Pídele a Claude que mejore el arte pidiéndole "laminas de conceptos artísticos" a Codex. Pídele que se las solicite el mismo a través de MCP. Cuando te muestre las láminas elige un concepto y empieza a "migrar" algunas partes, por ejemplo, partes del coche. Pide que cree un expositor con multivista y zoom de debug para ver cada modelo al detalle. Corrígele lo que no logre hacer bien. Itera itera itera.

Suerte. Lograras algo bueno muy pronto solo con Codex y codigo de Claude. Incluso no necesitas Codex, puedes pedir las laminas a ChatGPT directamente, pero pidele un prompt a Claude para eso.

Mucha suerte, es precioso lo que has hecho y estas haciendo. Mucho animo.

Edit: Ortografía.

replies.body: This is very much appreciated, thank you!
